# Chat site fixtures

Small, hand-written HTML excerpts that mirror the DOM structure each chat site
is known to use (roles, wrapper elements, prompt box, noise such as copy
buttons and screen-reader labels). They are **not** captures of live pages,
which need a login and change often. When a site redesign breaks an adapter,
paste the new structure here and update the adapter's selectors.

Every fixture holds the same conversation, so one test table covers them all.
